entries.label: pair_talk_001_01
entries.text: You are Katy, the owner of Patisserie Soapberry,\nare you not?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_02
entries.text: Yes, that’s me! And you must be Brassius from the\nArtazon Gym![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_03
entries.text: The cakes and sweets that you craft with such\ncare—they are truly avant-garde![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_04
entries.text: Would you consider, perhaps...a Grass-type\nPokémon for the motif of your next creation?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_05
entries.text: Oh, that might be interesting![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_06
entries.text: How about a Sunflora? Its round face would work\nreally well on a cake![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_001_07
entries.text: Oho! You have a true understanding of the arts!\nI cannot wait to collaborate with you on this![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_01
entries.text: Oh? Mr. Kofu, did you put on some weight?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_02
entries.text: Gahaha! Can’t help it when I’m comin’ up with\nnew dishes![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_03
entries.text: Ol’ man Kofu’s been makin’ plenty of deposits to\nthe belly bank![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_04
entries.text: Well, I just hope you’re watching out for your\nhealth.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_05
entries.text: Your cute li’l Venonat wallet might get squished\nby your belly if you’re not careful![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_002_06
entries.text: Gahaha! Thanks for that wallet, by the way! I’ve\nbeen puttin’ it to good use![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_01
entries.text: My name is Katy, and I’m here to say, I like\nmaking pastries for people to eat![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_02
entries.text: We patissiers bake fresh sweets and serve them\nall up in your face![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_03
entries.text: Katy, baby...that ain’t rap. You’re just stringin’\nwords together.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_04
entries.text: Rap’s gotta rhyme, or else you’re just talkin’ over\na beat! You need to hit the rhyming dictionary![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_05
entries.text: Aww... Rapping sure is hard! And why would\nI hit a poor dictionary? It didn’t do anything\r\nto me![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_003_06
entries.text: I can’t even tell if you’re serious right now!\nIt’s kinda scary—and that’s me saying that![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_01
entries.text: Say, Grusha, I have a question.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_02
entries.text: Huh? Wh-what do you want? Katy...right?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_03
entries.text: Do you happen to work out, Grusha?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_04
entries.text: Uh, yeah... Out of habit more than anything.\nWhy do you ask?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_05
entries.text: I see! Well then, when I’m giving you some nice\npastries, I’ll go for ones that are a little lighter on\r\nthe calories![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_06
entries.text: Huh? Wh-why would you give me pastries?\nI mean, I appreciate it and all, but...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_07
entries.text: Hehe, sweets always put smiles on people’s\nfaces![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_004_08
entries.text: Oh, I see... Right. Yeah. Well, thanks.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_01
entries.text: Oh, if it isn’t my favorite customer—Mr. Saguaro!\nI just adore that adorable apron of yours![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_02
entries.text: Thank you, it’s my pride and joy! I spent a lot of\ntime getting Jigglypuff’s face just right...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_03
entries.text: Oh, and your arms are so big! You must be a\nfiend with a whisk![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_04
entries.text: I, er... I’ve always put on muscle easily... Is this\ngoing somewhere?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_05
entries.text: Why don’t you come by Patisserie Soapberry\nsometime and put those muscles to use?\r\nEmployees get to eat the sweets for free![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_06
entries.text: Free sweets, you say?! What a tantalizing\nproposition...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_005_07
entries.text: Alas, I have duties to attend to at the academy!\nGet it together, Saguaro! Don’t give in![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_01
entries.text: I really like that one sweet you make, Katy. The\nTarountula-themed one...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_02
entries.text: Ah, the web macarons! They’re one of our more\npopular sweets at Patisserie Soapberry![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_03
entries.text: They sure ARE! I’ve tried to snag some after\nwork, but they’re always sold out...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_04
entries.text: We’re getting some new hires next month, so\nwe’ll be able to make more! You should stop by![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_05
entries.text: Huh?! For real?! Oh my gosh, that’s awesome![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_006_06
entries.text: This is the best news ever! I’d better let Sagu\nknow, too![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_01
entries.text: Pleeease, Brassius! Won’tcha come guest it up on\nmy stream?![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_02
entries.text: My answer, naturally, is...no![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_03
entries.text: Awww, c’monnn! Throw the Iono Zone a bone!\nWe Gym Leaders should all be friendos anyway![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_04
entries.text: I have absolutely no interest in getting any\ncloser to you.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_05
entries.text: If you were a bit more avant-garde, the answer\nmight be different.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_06
entries.text: Look, I gotta ask—what does “avant-garde” even\nmean? It’s been buggin’ me forever.[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_007_07
entries.text: The very fact you must ask shows how lacking in\navant-garde you are!\c\nYes, you lack that avant-garde...je ne sais quoi![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_01
entries.text: Brassius, my boy! I see yer still scrawny as a twig!\nGahaha![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_02
entries.text: Creating art is an arduous affair...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_03
entries.text: To create a true masterpiece requires sacrifice.\nIt is only natural that it would sap my strength.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_04
entries.text: I see, I see! But hear me out a bit...[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_05
entries.text: If ya eat good, hearty meals, you’d have more\nenergy to give, am I right? I’m thinkin’ that’d help\r\nya make even more of those masterpieces![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_06
entries.text: That...is a compelling argument![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_07
entries.text: I recall you are quite gifted in the culinary arts.\nCould you perhaps make something for me?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_008_08
entries.text: Gahaha! Just sit tight, my boy! Ol’ man Kofu will\nget you sorted in no time![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_01
entries.text: Hey, do you ever get scared that...like, y’know,\nall your talent will dry up some day?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_02
entries.text: Of course, I experienced such fear long ago! But\nnow, I am a stranger to fear altogether.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_03
entries.text: How’s that...?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_04
entries.text: I have faced my own death before. I perished\nonce—as an artist.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_05
entries.text: The fact that I still live feels like the greatest\nboon when I consider what I went through.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_06
entries.text: And no matter the setback I may face, it is little\nmore than a slight ache compared to that pain.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_07
entries.text: Hrrmph.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_08
entries.text: I suspected the same might be true for you,\nGrusha. Was I mistaken?[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_009_09
entries.text: It’s kinda uncool of you to act like you know what\nI’m going through, old man...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_01
entries.text: Halt! That ancient relic you have there...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_02
entries.text: It appears to be a piece of significant historical\nimport...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_03
entries.text: Oh, you can tell, can you? Very perceptive.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_04
entries.text: Where did you get it? If that relic is what I\nthink it is, it should not be in your possession...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_05
entries.text: Ah, I just happened upon it a while back. And\nyou...I’ve seen your face. You’re an artist, no?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_06
entries.text: Indeed! And you have the bearing of a teacher—\nalbeit one uncharacteristically light-fingered...[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_07
entries.text: Heh heh... I have no idea what you’re implying.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_010_08
entries.text: Ho ho... You cannot fool my keen eyes.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_01
entries.text: Thank you so much for your kind participation in\nmy class the other day![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_02
entries.text: Well, it would be unimaginable to turn down a\nrequest from my dear ol’ Hass.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_03
entries.text: You know, I imagine you would make a fine\nteacher in your own right, Brassie.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_04
entries.text: No, never... These impressionable youths would\nbe too great a burden for me![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_05
entries.text: Taking on the responsibility for such young,\nbudding lives... It is a weight I could not bear.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_06
entries.text: Indeed, being a teacher means shouldering the\nweight of that responsibility! I admit it’s not easy.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_07
entries.text: But that is why watching the growth of my\nstudents makes me cry tears of joy![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_011_08
entries.text: Truly, you were born to be a teacher, my\ndear Hass.[VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_01
entries.text: Yo, Larry! How come you don’t face the camera\nin your Gym Leader pic?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_02
entries.text: I prefer to keep a low profile...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_03
entries.text:
If people knew my face, I’d run the risk of
drawing crowds. That’d make it hard to get into
restaurants—or worse, I could get banned for
causing a disturbance in one.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_04
entries.text: Hwhaaa?! Hold up, back up! You DON’T want\npeople to recognize you?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_05
entries.text: Wait—that’s not even the bonkeriest part! How’d\nyou get the OK to do yours different?! Everyone\r\nelse has a regular pic![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_06
entries.text: Oh, that’s just a matter of knowing who to talk to.\nIt comes with experience, I suppose...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_012_07
entries.text: Daaang. You’re adulting like a pro, Larry.[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_01
entries.text: Nono, darling! Why haven’t I gotten an invite to\ncollab on your stream lately?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_02
entries.text: Gweh! W-well, to be super honest...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_03
entries.text: If people see you and me together...they’ll start\nnoticin’ all the ways you’re...better than me...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_04
entries.text: Don’t you talk about my friend that way! Your\nbeauty deserves to be shared![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_05
entries.text: Aw, Tulip! Stop! I can’t even![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_06
entries.text: Ideal beauty is always possible! It’s there, just\nwaiting to be realized![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_07
entries.text: I’ll sign you up for a bunch of Emotional\nSpectrum Practices to get you started![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_013_08
entries.text: Uh, Tulip? Stop! I can’t even![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_01
entries.text: Iono of the Iono Zone, right?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_02
entries.text: Say whaaat?! Grusha, you know ’bout my\nstreams?![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_03
entries.text: I used to watch them before competitions and\nstuff, yeah. Cheered me up a lot.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_04
entries.text: I’ve known about you since before you started\ndoing that weird greeting thing.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_05
entries.text: Holy geez! You’ve been on board basically since\nday one! I’m thrilled—and kinda embarrassed![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_06
entries.text: I think I like your older content better, if I’m\nbeing honest. You took more risks, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_07
entries.text: Nowadays it feels like it’s all about gettin’ the\nmost clicks—all the sponsorships and everything.\r\nPretty uncool, if you ask me.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_014_08
entries.text: Ooof, you’re one of THOSE fans! This is why I\nquit reading the comments![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_01
entries.text: I’m extremely sorry for causing you so much\ntrouble...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_02
entries.text: Oh, it’s quite all right. I rather enjoyed the\nwhole affair.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_03
entries.text: Still, if I’d known you were the distinguished\ndirector of Paldea’s prestigious academy, I’d\r\nnever have roped you into a livestream.[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_04
entries.text: Let alone given you a silly nickname...that I\nrepeated...a lot...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_05
entries.text: Ah. You refer to Mr. Walksabout, I presume?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_06
entries.text: Erk. Y-yes. That one.[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_07
entries.text:
Well, I actually thought the name “Walksabout”
was rather charming and whimsical.\c
I cannot deny it was an excellent moniker. You
clearly have an aptitude for naming things.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_015_08
entries.text: P-please! Stop taking this so well! I’m gonna\nfaint from sheer embarrassment![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_01
entries.text: Bonjour, mademoiselle Magnemite! How are you\ndoing this lovely day?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_02
entries.text: A friendo from another continento! ’Ello, ’ello,\nhola, ciao and bonjour! I’m from the Iono Zone![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_03
entries.text: Waouh! It’s you! The one who says ce méli-mélo\nde mots—the famed user of this mishmash![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_04
entries.text: What a chance this meeting is—en garde, Iono!\nJe m’appelle Salvatore. My name is Salvatore![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_05
entries.text: “En garde?!” Sounds like you’re out to battle,\nMonsewer Salvatore![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_06
entries.text: I’ll take you on. I just need a sec to set up my\nstream! Get me? I need time![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_07
entries.text:
Tyme?\c
Non non, I’m not Ms. Tyme—though I’m flattered
you would mistake me for such a great beauty!\c
Haha, je rigole! Just a little joke from me![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_016_08
entries.text: Dude! Even I can’t keep up with whatever this bit\nis you’re doing![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_01
entries.text: Larry! Just the foodie I wanted to see! I need\nyer input on somethin’![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_02
entries.text: Uh, I’m not sure if I’d call myself a “foodie”...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_03
entries.text: I wanted to pick yer brains ’bout some ideas for\na new dish at my restaurant![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_04
entries.text: ...A new dish, you say?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_05
entries.text: I’d warn against anything gimmicky, since that\nwould only work in the short term.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_06
entries.text: Personally, I think you’d be better off maintaining\nthe high quality of the dishes you already have...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_07
entries.text: But if I must suggest something, I have noticed\nthat the Kofu Lounge lacks options for dessert.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_017_08
entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Ya make a good point! That’s\nexactly the kinda idea I needed![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_01
entries.text: You tried out that hot new pose I taught you,\nright, Kofy?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]’Course I did! Me an’ [VAR 0x0100(0000)]
tried
it
out
together,
in
fact![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_03
entries.text: Ooh! What a pair! I’d love to see how that pic\nturned out.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_04
entries.text: Lucky for you, I’ve got it on hand! Look at li’l ol’\nme there, almost fallin’ offa h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser hand...[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_05
entries.text: Pffft! Hahaha! I didn’t think YOU’D be the one\nin that part of the pose, Kofu![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_018_06
entries.text: Though honestly, I think it turned out even\nbetter this way...[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_01
entries.text: Say, I know you... Yer one of them regulars at\nmy little restaurant, aren’t ya?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_02
entries.text: Oh my! Kofu from the Kofu Lounge, right?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_03
entries.text: Ol’ man Kofu, at yer service! ’Preciate yer\nbusiness, I do![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_04
entries.text: Why, hello hello! The name’s Jacq.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_05
entries.text: I gotta say, it’s a pleasure watchin’ ya polish off\na big ol’ plate of my Dandan Noodles. You don’t\r\neven break a sweat![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_06
entries.text: Aw shucks, you’re going to embarrass me, going\non like that. I just love spicy food, that’s all.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_07
entries.text: Sorry for always using up so much of that chili\nsauce you put out on the tables.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_019_08
entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Ya add MORE spice to ’em?!\nWhat a catch! What a great catch![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_01
entries.text: Please do pardon my forwardness, but...you\nhave quite an impressive physique.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_02
entries.text: Why, you don’t look too shabby yerself! You do\nsome kinda sport, or...?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_03
entries.text: I dabbled in wrestling during my school days.\nYou?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_04
entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Wrestlin’, eh? I do a bit o’ sumo\nnow and then myself. Just as a hobby, y’see![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_05
entries.text: Oh?! Sumo, you say?! Quite impressive![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_06
entries.text: Oh, it’s nothin’. Gahahaha![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: pair_talk_020_07
entries.text: With that physique, it’s no wonder... Hehehe![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_01
entries.text: Thank you for doing business with us regarding\nthe redesign of the Montenevera battle court.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_02
entries.text: Oh, yeah! I forgot we hired you for that.\nNo sweat, baby. You did right by us too![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_03
entries.text: That new battle court’s pitch-perfect for live\nshows and as ghostly as I wanted.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_04
entries.text: My sister loved her old rocky court, but my\nHoundstone couldn’t burrow into that![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_05
entries.text: Ah, I see... To be honest, though, that project was\na huge boon to myself.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_06
entries.text: Without it, I would have landed zero contracts\nthat year.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_021_07
entries.text: Bahaha! Sure you’re not a Ghost-type user, Larry?\nSometimes seems like you’re barely stayin’ alive![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_02
entries.text: C’mon, Larry! You gotta project more. Let’s start\nwith a simple enunciation exercise![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_03
entries.text: UNIQUE UNOVA! YOU KNOW YOU NEED\nUNIQUE UNOVA![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_04
entries.text: Unique Unova... You know you need unique\nUnova...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_05
entries.text: What was that?! It’s like you’re not even trying![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_06
entries.text: Correct. I wasn’t trying.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_07
entries.text: Oooh, the nerve... I swear, you’re in for another\nlecture from Hassel.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_08
entries.text: So all I have to worry about is a scolding...? Let\nme know when my job’s at stake.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_022_09
entries.text: Uuugh! Hassel, you gotta come tag in for me! I’ve\nhad it with this guy![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_01
entries.text: Mr. Laaarrrrrryyy![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_02
entries.text: What can I do for you, Poppy?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_03
entries.text: Am I your best friend, Mr. Larry?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_05
entries.text: Hm. I don’t think any answer is a good answer for\nthis question.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_06
entries.text: What was that, Mr. Larry?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_07
entries.text: Did you know, Poppy, that Komala spend their\nentire lives sleeping?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_08
entries.text: Heeey! Don’t change the subject![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_09
entries.text: Indecisive grown-ups are the worst, you know![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_023_10
entries.text: I got scolded anyway. I just can’t win...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_01
entries.text: Honestly, Larry! Always with the poor attitude! Is\nsome enthusiasm too much to ask for?![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_03
entries.text: Larry? Larry! Are you even listening to me?![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_04
entries.text: If I answer honestly, will it make you angrier?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_05
entries.text: ...What do you mean?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_06
entries.text: Being honest is commendable! Why, it may help\ncalm me down rather than make me angrier.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_07
entries.text: Well, I was asleep just now, actually.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_024_08
entries.text: GRRRAAAGH![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_01
entries.text: You seem to be enjoying this business trip, Larry.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_02
entries.text: Huh? Well, I suppose...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_03
entries.text: It’s...part of my job, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_04
entries.text: I see... So you would happily travel anywhere, as\nlong as it was for your job?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_05
entries.text: What? No, that’s not—[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_06
entries.text: As it just so happens, we’ve decided to send a\nPaldea League representative to a competition\r\nbeing held in a certain region.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_07
entries.text: I took the liberty of recommending you for the\nrole, Larry.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_025_08
entries.text: What did I do to deserve such a...lovely boss...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_01
entries.text: Y’know that weird sushi joint we got up in\nMontenevera? High Roller?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_02
entries.text: Yeah, I know the place. Never been, though.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_03
entries.text: Well, everyone I see go in there to eat comes\nout lookin’ like they got one foot in the grave.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_04
entries.text: Oof. Their sushi’s gotta be some kind of terrible\nif that’s the case.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_05
entries.text: You said it, baby! So how about we go check out\nexactly what kind of terrible it is?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_06
entries.text: I’ll be honest—I don’t get how you went from “it\nmust be terrible” to “we should go check it out.”[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_07
entries.text: I gotta taste the fear, Grusha! Ain’t that what\nfear’s for?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_026_08
entries.text: Is that how it works...? Well, why not, I guess.\nLet’s check it out when I’m feeling up to it.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_01
entries.text: Hold up, lady. You’re big-time haunted! There’s a\nghost practically ridin’ piggyback on you![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_02
entries.text: Is that so? I should have guessed. My shoulders\nhave been unusually stiff recently.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_03
entries.text: Baby, that spirit is vengeful like no other. What’d\nyou do to get hexed that hard?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_04
entries.text: Heh... If I had to guess...it probably happened\nwhen I snuck into that ancient tomb...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_05
entries.text: Oh, but don’t mind my ramblings. I tend to get\nhexed a lot. It’s an occupational hazard.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_027_06
entries.text: If you say so. I can go ahead and exorcise that\nectoplasm, but...maybe take it easy on those\r\njobs, all right?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_01
entries.text: Ryme! How are you, dear? Have you been\nwearing that cardigan I knitted for you?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_02
entries.text: Sis...you know I’m the MC of RIP, right?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_03
entries.text: You really think a beige cardigan goes with, you\nknow, my entire image?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_04
entries.text: Oh, where’s the harm! We’re both old ladies now.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_05
entries.text: And it’s awfully cold in Montenevera! Don’t you\nknow that the cold is a killer for the elderly?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_06
entries.text: OK! Fine! I’ll wear it when I’m off the clock![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_028_07
entries.text: Oh, I’m so glad! You’ll have to send me a photo\nof yourself wearing it. Promise me![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_01
entries.text: A Gym specializing in Double Battles...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_02
entries.text: I admit I had my concerns, at first. But I think now\nI must commend you, Ms. Ryme.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_03
entries.text: Your new approach has accomplished so much.\nMore than I can measure, in fact.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_04
entries.text: Hah! That’s a cute sentiment. But I gotta say...[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_05
entries.text: Big talk when you won’t even darken my door!\nYou let a kid do your Gym inspection tour![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_06
entries.text: I think it’s time we let the moves do the talkin’!\nFace me, or face Paldea and start walkin’![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_07
entries.text: Oh my. I didn’t expect to be treated to a live\nrap performance from the MC of RIP herself.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_08
entries.text: That was amazing, indeed![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_029_09
entries.text: Hmph! Never one to let yourself get pinned\ndown, huh? You’re shrewd, Geeta...and I dig it.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_01
entries.text: I only ever see you alongside the ever-dazzling\nGeeta... I’m just realizing how lovely YOU are![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_02
entries.text: How would you like to model for my company?\nExclusively, of course![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_03
entries.text: Ahhh, I knew this beauty of mine would catch\nsomeone’s eye sooner or later...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_04
entries.text: I can’t believe such a lovely canvas for my\nmakeup was right in front of me all this time![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_05
entries.text: My third eye must be absolutely stuck shut!\nLet alone the other two![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_06
entries.text: Er. I only see two eyes from where I’m standing.\c\nAnd sorry, but taking care of the boss is a\nfull-time job. I can’t take on anything else...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_030_07
entries.text: Well, darling, if you ever get tired of Geeta, my\ndoor’s always open.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_01
entries.text: When did you say I’d get to stop helping out\nthe Alfornada Gym?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_02
entries.text: Huh? I don’t remember saying you could stop...[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_03
entries.text: What?! You can’t be serious![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_04
entries.text: Well, we never really nailed down an end date,\ndid we?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_05
entries.text: Come on, Dendra... What kind of teacher goes\naround breaking their word? That’s a no-no![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_06
entries.text: Grrr... But YOU’RE the one who never clarified\nan end date! Why are you making it sound like\r\nit’s my fault?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_07
entries.text: OK, I demand a rematch to re-decide the terms\nof this agreement![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_08
entries.text: If you say so... But this time, if you lose, you’ve\ngot to do anything I say forever![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_031_09
entries.text: Why do the stakes have to be so high for just\nme, Tulip?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_01
entries.text: I think I know who you are. You teach at the\nacademy back in Paldea, don’t you?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_02
entries.text: Y-yes, I do! But why do you know who I am,\nMs. Tulip?![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_03
entries.text: Well, Dendra told me that one of her coworkers\nwas simply adorable.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_04
entries.text: She MUST have meant you, darling![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_05
entries.text: Um, th-thank you?! I don’t know why you can\nbe so sure she was referring to me, but—[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_06
entries.text: Wait, you know Dendra?![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_07
entries.text: Well, obvs. We’ve been the tightest of tight since\nway back.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_08
entries.text: Really? I didn’t know that... I never get to talk\nabout this kind of thing with her, though. She’s\r\njust too...energetic for me, sometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_032_09
entries.text: Yeah, she’s always been like that. It’s pretty cute,\nno?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_01
entries.text: I’ve been informed about your impressive work\nas the Alfornada Gym Leader, Ms. Tulip.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_02
entries.text: Oooh. Someone’s got an ear to the ground.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_03
entries.text: But anyway, yes—I’m a firm believer in not\nslacking on what needs doing.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_04
entries.text: How very admirable. Particularly since you are\nno doubt busy with your regular vocation.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_05
entries.text: Well, I think YOU would know all about being\nbusy, wouldn’t you, Geeta?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: pair_talk_033_06

[VAR 0x0100(0000)]

now on?\c
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe did a really excellent job of it.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
