entries.label: pair_talk_034_01
entries.text: So, Ms. Rika—[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_02
entries.text: Aw, don’t be stiff. Just call me Rika. Or maybe\n“good ol’ Rika” if you HAVE to be all respectful.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_03
entries.text: Uh, nah... That’s way uncool...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_04
entries.text: So, I wanted to ask you, Ms. Rika. Since you’re\nin the Pokémon League...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_05
entries.text: Uh-huh? Since good ol’ Rika’s in the Pokémon\nLeague...?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_06
entries.text: You know what? Never mind.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_034_07
entries.text: Nahaha! Sorry, sorry![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_01
entries.text: Wow, mister! Are you a prince from somewhere?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_02
entries.text: Huh? Do you mean me...?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_03
entries.text: Yes, I do![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_04
entries.text: Why are you hiding your mouth like that?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_05
entries.text: Oh, this? This is just to keep my neck warm...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_06
entries.text: I think you should pull it down so people can see\nyour whole face![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_07
entries.text: Nah, it’s pretty chilly in here...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_08
entries.text: But I wanna see your whole faaaaaace![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_09
entries.text: ...OK. Fine. Just for a sec, though.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_035_10
entries.text: Oh wow! You really ARE a prince![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_01
entries.text: Riiikaaa! I’m soooooo annoyed![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_02
entries.text: Whoa, what’s going on? I don’t often see you so\nriled up, Poppy.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_03
entries.text: I came to Bloo-berry as part of our job! But\npeople keep mistaking me for some lost kid![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_04
entries.text: Oh c’mon now, Poppy. You know that’s just\n’cause...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_05
entries.text: you’re so gosh-darn adorable![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_06
entries.text: Huh? People think you’re lost if you’re adorable?[VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_07
entries.text: That they do, squirt! Haven’t you ever heard that\nold saying? “If you adore something, lose it”!\c\nAt least I think that’s how it goes. Pretty sure...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_036_08
entries.text: Ooooooh, I see! Wow, you’re real smart, Rika![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_01
entries.text: So, what’s the haps?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_02
entries.text: Oh, I’m doing fine. I get along, pas à pas,\nstep by step.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_03
entries.text: Nahaha! That’s good to hear![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_04
entries.text: And you? Comment vas-tu?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_05
entries.text: Ol’ Rika’s same as always—my energy’s super-\nhigh magnitude![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_06
entries.text: Hahaha! I’m pas surpris—not surprised at all—\nto hear such high spirits from this old Rika![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_037_07
entries.text: I know, right?\c\nSay, quick question... Who were you again?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_01
entries.text: Whenever I’m deeply moved, I can’t help\nmyself—the tears just flow like waterfalls![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_02
entries.text: Aw, but that’s a good thing! It means you’ve got\na warm, caring heart... I think?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_03
entries.text: Ah, but I do waste so much time crying! If it\nweren’t for you, we’d never be able to finish\r\nany Elite Test![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_04
entries.text: Oh, don’t worry about it! I love talking and\nkeeping things moving and all that![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_05
entries.text: Is that so? I’m a little surprised—I’d have thought\nsuch duties would be painful for you.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_06
entries.text: After all, you are normally rather prone to\nclowning around...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_07
entries.text: Wait, clowning around...?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_038_08
entries.text: I’m the only member of the Elite Four that gets\nanything done![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_01
entries.text: Grandpa Haaasselll![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_02
entries.text: Hello there, Poppy. Are you working hard as a\ncoach?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_03
entries.text: Yes, I am![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_04
entries.text: I know I’m still small, but I’m doing my very, very\nbest![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_05
entries.text: Oh, I’m so proud of you, Poppy! You’re but a\nyoung child, and yet...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_06
entries.text: You’re—*sniffle*—worgig so hard...wid all de\nadults... Such dedigashun...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_07
entries.text: BWUUUH huh huh huh huh!\nHUUUUUUH huh hoi hoi hoi...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_08
entries.text: Oh no! Another one of your crying fits, Grandpa\nHassel?![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_039_09
entries.text: There there, don’t cry. I’ll give you a hug![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_01
entries.text: All your Pokémon are tough as steel, Amarys![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_02
entries.text: That’s right. Steely as a Metagross.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_03
entries.text: Is that not true for you as well, Poppy?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_04
entries.text: It is! I’m a girl of steel, after all![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_05
entries.text: Haha... Yes, your Tinkaton is indeed wonderful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_040_06
entries.text: Yay! Your Skarmory’s also really tough! And your\nEmpoleon too![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_01
entries.text: Wait—what’s a little girl doing here?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_02
entries.text: I’m Poppy! Nice to meet you![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_03
entries.text: Oh! Um, yes, it’s very nice to meet you. You’re\nsuch a well-mannered child...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_04
entries.text: I’m an Elite Four member too! I’m here as part\nof my job![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_05
entries.text: WHAT?! A-a child like you is...? But you’re...\nyou’re...you’re just TOO CUTE![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_06
entries.text: Do you want some juice, Poppy? Or maybe a\ncookie? Do you like cookies?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_041_07
entries.text: I love cookies! I’ll gladly have some![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_01
entries.text: You must remember that you are representing\nour storied academy at all times.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_02
entries.text:
Do you really feel it is acceptable to do so
looking like you’ve just rolled out of bed?\c
And good gracious, are those SANDALS you’re
wearing?![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_03
entries.text: Hehe, whoopsie. I promise I’ll remember to put\non something more professional next time...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_04
entries.text: I don’t think I’ve ever seen you wear anything\nthat could be described as “professional,” Jacq.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_05
entries.text: Do you even iron that lab coat of yours? From\nthe stains splattered across the fabric, could it\r\nbe that you don’t even launder—[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_042_06
entries.text: C-come on, Director! Please! Have mercy![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_01
entries.text: Traveled all the way here to keep an eye on me,\ndid you?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_02
entries.text: Ah. You seem displeased. Is my presence\ninconveniencing you in some way, Ms. Raifort?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_03
entries.text: Not at all. You know me—I’m only interested in\nbeing the best teacher I can be.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_04
entries.text: Well, that is certainly good to hear.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_05
entries.text:
As long as I breathe, I will be sure that you
continue to fulfill your duties as a teacher.\c
A good, honest occupation—wouldn’t you agree,
Ms. Raifort?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_06
entries.text: Heh, wasting your time on me... You really take\nto interesting hobbies, don’t you, old man?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_043_07
entries.text: Though I admit I am fond of your way of thinking.\nIt’s charmingly...traditional.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_01
entries.text: Mr. Clavell, I must apologize again for what\nhappened the other day...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_02
entries.text: I was entirely in the wrong for failing to knock.\nYour office is your own private space, of course.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_03
entries.text: N-no, that’s quite all right. I truly am sorry to\nhave startled you with such an unbecoming scene.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_04
entries.text: No, please! I should have been more careful![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_05
entries.text: Really, Ms. Tyme, I do not see it that way at all.\nThe blame for this incident lies squarely with me.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_06
entries.text: You’re sure? Well, if you are, I did have a few\nquestions about what I saw that day...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_07
entries.text: What were you doing dressed up in a student’s\nuniform, all alone in your office?\c\nAnd why were you wearing that wig?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_044_08
entries.text: A-ah, well, you see...it’s a rather long story...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_01
entries.text: Hello, Director! Osu! You sure are looking lively\ntoday![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_02
entries.text: The same to you, Ms. Dendra. You seem\nsplendidly energetic as always.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_03
entries.text: Hahaha! Well...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_04
entries.text: Bein’ energetic is my thing![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_05
entries.text: I see you have a clear understanding of your own\nstrengths—a valuable asset, indeed.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_045_06
entries.text: Please do share some of that overflowing energy\nwith the students of Blueberry Academy, too.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_01
entries.text: How are you finding life back at our academy\nsince your return, Miss Penny?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_02
entries.text: Huh? Like, in what way...?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_03
entries.text: Well, are you having any difficulties with your\nstudies or other school activities?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_04
entries.text: Uhhh... Studying’s never any trouble for me.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_05
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And I’m having fun hanging out with everyone in
Team Star, so that’s been great.\c
Oh! And I also got to go on a trip with
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
and
some
other
friends![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_06
entries.text: Oho! It sounds like you’re enjoying your time at\nthe academy a great deal, then.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_07
entries.text: Ah. There is one thing—helping out at the\nPokémon League has been pretty tough.\c\nChairwoman Geeta literally terrifies me![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_08
entries.text: She’s, like, SO intense. Even when she’s smiling!\nIs there any way you could help me out with her?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_046_09
entries.text: I’m afraid that’s...quite beyond my power.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_01
entries.text: You really are something, Ms. Raifort![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_02
entries.text: I can’t believe you were able to figure out where\nthose Pokémon had been sealed away just from\r\nthose old writings you found![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_03
entries.text: Heh... It proved to be simplicity itself, once I\nfollowed the clues of history.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_04
entries.text: But in the end, it turned out that a crook like\nmyself could never have opened the seals. So I\r\nlet a friend have the treasure.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_05
entries.text: So you formed a hypothesis based on clues, then\nput it to the test. I suppose history and biology\r\nare similar in that way.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_06
entries.text: Speaking of testing things... I was just considering\ntesting out the effects of a certain ancient ritual.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_07
entries.text: It just so happens that I need an adult male as a\nsacri—I mean, assistant. Care to help out?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_047_08
entries.text: I’d love to help! Count me in![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_01
entries.text: Indeed, there’s nothing so difficult as knowing\nhow best to correct a student’s behavior...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_02
entries.text: Wait, even you struggle with it, Ms. Tyme?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_03
entries.text: Of course! There’s no teacher out there who\ntakes pleasure in having to scold a child.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_04
entries.text:
But sometimes it must be done—even if it makes
the children hate you.\c
It’s our duty as the ones tasked with their
education and development.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_05
entries.text: I suppose...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_06
entries.text: Hmmm. I don’t really like doing it, but I guess\nI’ve got to do my best! Thank you, Ms. Tyme.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_048_07
entries.text: Don’t give up, Mr. Jacq! You can do it![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_01
entries.text: Mr. Jacq! Mon sauveur! I still have not thanked\nyou enough for the help you did me and Pawmi![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_02
entries.text: Wow, really? I’m glad to hear I was a help. And\nhow has your little Pawmi been doing since then?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_03
entries.text: Pawmi is doing très bien. Every day, it comes to\nmy classes together with me.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_04
entries.text: It’s still plutôt timide—quite shy!—but it has\nbegun to use its voice from time to time.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_05
entries.text: In fact, it’s created a bit of a stir among my\nstudents. They say that anyone who hears its cry\r\nwill have the greatest of luck![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_049_06
entries.text: Amazing! Sounds like Pawmi’s become quite\nthe star![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_01
entries.text: Thank you for always patching me up when I\ntake a tumble, Nurse Miriam...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_02
entries.text: Oh, it’s no big deal![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_03
entries.text: I mean, it’s not like I’m just gonna stand there\nwhen you take a fall like that right in front of me.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_04
entries.text: Haha... I guess not.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_05
entries.text: But honestly...you really oughta be more careful,\nMr. Jacq![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_06
entries.text: I think the only person who gets more scraped\nup than you is Dendra...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_07
entries.text: Oooh! You mean when it comes to injuries, I’m in\nsecond place?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_08
entries.text: I guess I’ll need to work hard to reach the top!\nRight, Nurse Miriam?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_09
entries.text: If you’re gonna crack jokes about it, you can get\nscuffed up for all I care! Be serious![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_050_10
entries.text: Yes, ma’am...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_01
entries.text: Ms. Raifort, will you be attending next week’s\nstaff meeting?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_02
entries.text: Put me down as absent, please.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_03
entries.text: I’d much rather spend my time contemplating\nancient wisdom.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_04
entries.text: Oh, how sad to hear. We do always miss your\npresence at our meetings...[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_05
entries.text: I’d love for you to come and give us all a nice\nlong talk about history.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_06
entries.text: Oh? So you are interested in history?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_07
entries.text: Heh... My dear lady, I misjudged you. You may\nbe worth my time, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_08
entries.text: Perhaps it would not be amiss for me to converse\nwith my elders from time to time...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_051_09
entries.text: Oh, wonderful! Then I’ll be sure to mark you\ndown as attending![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_01
entries.text: You seem unusually tired today, Ms. Raifort.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_02
entries.text: Is it that obvious? I was hoping nobody would\nnotice... Heh...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_03
entries.text: Don’t fret about me. I was simply up late last\nnight doing research.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_04
entries.text: I was reading my way through a stack of 20 or so\nhistory books in the academy entrance hall, and\r\nwhen I looked up, it was suddenly morning.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_05
entries.text: Oho... You’re quite devoted to your work.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_06
entries.text: I imagine you’ve spent many a night like that,\ncultivating the knowledge to guide your students.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_07
entries.text: What are you going on about? It’s my hobby.\nNothing to do with my work at all.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_052_09
entries.text: And now why are you silent, all of a sudden?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_01
entries.text: Nurse Miriam, I haven’t had the chance to offer\nmy congratulations on your certification![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_02
entries.text: Oh, thank you so, so, so much, Ms. Tyme![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_03
entries.text: Will you start teaching classes next school year?\nEveryone is looking forward to it![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_04
entries.text: Yes, I will! I’ll try my best not to cause the rest\nof the teachers any trouble![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_05
entries.text: Oh, goodness, how sweet! You’ll be the angel of\nthe entire academy, not just the nurse’s office![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_053_06
entries.text: Don’t you start with that “angel” stuff, too,\nMs. Tyme! You’re not safe from my wrath![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_01
entries.text: Penny, dear! You were the only one to get a\nperfect score on our last test![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_02
entries.text: Huh? Oh. Cool...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_03
entries.text: I mean...it wasn’t all that hard.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_04
entries.text: I even added some trick questions, but they didn’t\ncatch you for a moment. It’s very impressive.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_05
entries.text: Actually, it’s pretty easy to tell which of your\nquestions are the trick ones...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_06
entries.text: Some of the other teachers, well...they make tests\nwith trick questions that are flat-out mean.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_07
entries.text: Oh! So that means you think I’m nice, then?\nWell, I’m delighted to hear it![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_08
entries.text: Huh? Errr. I...guess?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_09
entries.text: I mean, well, you’re not one of my least favorite\nteachers...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_054_10
entries.text: I adore you as well, my dear![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_01
entries.text: Bonjour, Ms. Dendra! You seem to be in high\nspirits as usual![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_02
entries.text: Osu, Mr. Salvatore![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_03
entries.text: You know what? I had a question for you, in fact.\nSi je peux?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_04
entries.text: I’ve long wondered about the definition of that\nword you always say—“Osu”![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_05
entries.text: The definition...of osu?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_06
entries.text: It’s a bit hard to explain, actually...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_07
entries.text: It seems to be something like a greeting you can\nuse à tout moment—anytime, day or night.\r\nIs that not so?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_08
entries.text: Now that you mention it, it is used a lot as a\ngreeting, but...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_09
entries.text: It hypes you up! That’s the word I was looking\nfor! It fills you with fighting spirit![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_10
entries.text: Splendid... So it fills you with the fighting spirit.\nL’esprit combatif... Could I also partake in it?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_11
entries.text: Yeah, let’s osu it up! Smash through your limits![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_055_12
entries.text: Then I will join you! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_01
entries.text: What’s your wife like, Salvatore?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_02
entries.text: Oh! Nurse Miriam! You’re curious about ma\nfemme—my dear wife?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_03
entries.text: Of course! Don’t you know that all the students\nare gossiping about what she might be like?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_04
entries.text: Ma femme has eyes so big and round! And\ncheeks so lovely and soft![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_05
entries.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh! What about her personality?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_06
entries.text: Well, she is a little shy, but she is always clinging\nto my legs so adorably.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_07
entries.text: Clinging...to your legs? What do you...?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_08
entries.text: Oops, that’s not my wife I’m describing—that’s\njust Pawmi! Hahaha! Funny, no?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_056_09
entries.text: Your wife must be nice if she’s willing to go along\nwith these antics...[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_01
entries.text: Mr. Salvatore! I didn’t realize you were here too![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_02
entries.text: Waouh! My dear Arven! Did you come all this\nway just to meet me?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_03
entries.text: Oh, uh, no... Not really...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_04
entries.text: But since you’re here and all, can you help me\nwith some of my homework?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_05
entries.text: Bien sûr! Of course I will![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_06
entries.text: I’ve noticed that you are much more passionné—\nthat is, passionate—about your studies lately.\r\nIs there some cause for the sudden change?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_07
entries.text: Yeah...I guess you could say that![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_08
entries.text: I’ve got friends now that I wanna be on the same\nlevel with. I don’t wanna be dragging them down![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_09
entries.text: The same level? Oh, like in les jeux vidéo—\nthe video games! These are friends you play les\r\nvideo games with, non? How nice for you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: pair_talk_057_10
entries.text: Ah, man... I don’t think we’re understanding one\nanother here, are we?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_01
entries.text: I trust that your culinary training has been going\nswimmingly since we last spoke?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_02
entries.text: Actually, I reached my goal, so I’m taking a break\nfrom my training![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_03
entries.text: Oh, is that so? In that case all is well, I suppose...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_04
entries.text: If you ever need assistance in your culinary\npursuits, I’m just a shout away.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_05
entries.text: Just let me know when you are ready to begin\nyour training again.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_06
entries.text: You’ll help me train?! You sure?! Well, no time\nlike the present—let’s get started![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_07
entries.text: I wanna do some squats but need some extra\nweight! Why don’tcha get on my back?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_058_08
entries.text: Have you been listening to anything I’ve been\nsaying?![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_01
entries.text: Thanks for that sandwich you made me, by\nthe way.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_02
entries.text: It was all right, I guess? Not too bad.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_03
entries.text: Really?! Yesss! I’m so happy you enjoyed my\ncooking![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_04
entries.text: It must have been real tasty, seeing how you were\ncrying tears of joy and everything![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_05
entries.text: I wasn’t THAT happy! Pump the brakes a little,\nDendra![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_06
entries.text: So...when’s the next...uh, “meal”?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_07
entries.text: Huh?! Well, I mean, I’m done with my sandwich\ntraining now...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_08
entries.text: Huh? Done? Just like that?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_09
entries.text: Do you...maybe wanna make some sandwiches\ntogether sometime?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_10
entries.text: No way! Miriam’s handmade sandwiches?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_11
entries.text: I’m so pumped! I’m gonna work up an appetite\nstarting now![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_059_12
entries.text: We’re making them TOGETHER! You better do\nyour part too, Dendra![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_01
entries.text: Hey, Ms. Dendra! I really wanna get stronger.\nCan you help me?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_02
entries.text: Even stronger than you are now?! Haha, typical\nNemona![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_03
entries.text: As long as you keep that attitude, you’ll get\nstronger for sure![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_04
entries.text: Heh. Thanks for saying so![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_05
entries.text:
So, I know you taught us three main points:
a well-balanced party, moves for every scenario,
and knowing when to Terastallize!\c
What else should I be looking out for?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_06
entries.text: There’s one more thing... Hot-blooded power![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_07
entries.text: Power? And it’s hot-blooded? Whoa![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_08
entries.text: That power will come in real clutch when you’re\nup against the ropes![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_09
entries.text: I think I get it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_10
entries.text: Train up that hot-blooded power, and obliterate\nyour limits! Osu!!![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: pair_talk_060_11
entries.text: Heck yeah! Osu!!![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_01
entries.text: Hassel... Is there anything troubling you regarding\nthe day-to-day operations of the League?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_02
entries.text: Anything troubling me?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_03
entries.text: Hmm, well... The bell that tells us when it’s time\nto enter the Elite Test room has been broken for\r\na while. It would be nice to get that fixed.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_04
entries.text: Ah, yes... It’s been several months since it broke\nnow, hasn’t it? I apologize for the inconvenience.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_05
entries.text: I have already contacted the repair crew, but\ntheir schedule is unfortunately completely full...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_06
entries.text: I suppose everyone is very busy nowadays.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_07
entries.text: It’s not a high priority, to be honest. We just\nshout to the next Elite Four member when it’s\r\ntheir turn to battle. It’s just that—[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_08
entries.text: Say no more, Hassel.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_061_09
entries.text: The problem is Larry, correct?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_01
entries.text: Hey, Mr. Hassel! Did I tell you I’ve been training\na Kommo-o?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_02
entries.text: Ah, the Scaly Pokémon Kommo-o! A unique\ndragon indeed![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_03
entries.text: Yeah! I met it in Kitakami—and it’s awesome!\nI wanna try all kinds of strats with it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_04
entries.text: Then allow me to offer some advice!!![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_05
entries.text: You must utilize its sturdy defenses and use\nClangorous Soul the first chance you get![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_06
entries.text: Accomplish that, and the scaly dragon will\nindeed become your key to victory![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_07
entries.text: All right! I LOVE victory![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_08
entries.text: I’ve been thinking a lot about what other moves\nto teach it! Can I run ’em by you?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_062_09
entries.text: I would be more than happy to offer my input.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_01
entries.text: Why, if it isn’t young Drayton! I didn’t know you\nwere a member of this club.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_02
entries.text: Gwuh! Mr. Hassel?![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_03
entries.text: Your grandfather Drayden informed me that\nyou were forced to repeat a year of school...\r\nSeveral years, in fact![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_04
entries.text: Yeesh. Thanks for letting the whole world know,\nGrandpa...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_05
entries.text: Fine, so I got held back a couple times! It is what\nit is, all right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_06
entries.text: Doesn’t life have room for taking a stroll on the\nscenic path sometimes?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_07
entries.text: Indeed. But studying is also an excellent way to\nbroaden said path, is it not?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_08
entries.text: I am not suggesting you should desperately try\nto live up to the expectations of others.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_09
entries.text: I simply hope that you spend your days as a\nstudent in a way that you do not regret later on.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: pair_talk_063_10
entries.text: *sigh*\nI get it, Mr. Hassel, I get it. Please just give it a\r\nrest already.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_01
entries.text: Pssst, Sagu, did you try the...y’know...?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_02
entries.text: Are you referring to Kanto Crepes’ limited-time\ndish, the banana deluxe crepe?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_03
entries.text: Yeah! But wait... Are you OK discussing it out in\nthe open like this? What if someone hears?[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_04
entries.text: A certain student urged me to no longer be so\nhush-hush about my love for sweets.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_05
entries.text: I’ve decided to embrace my sweet tooth! I will\nno longer be ashamed![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_06
entries.text: Oh, that’s great![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_07
entries.text: So that means the next time we go on a sweets\ntour, you don’t need to go out in disguise![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_08
entries.text: Indeed! I’m free to enjoy fine sweets in my\nregular attire![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_064_09
entries.text: I don’t think the disguise did much anyway...\nNot too many people are built like you.[VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_01
entries.text: Arven, my boy, how’s it going with that dish\nyou’ve been working on?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_02
entries.text: I think it’s really coming along, thanks to some\nhelp from [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_03
entries.text: I’ve been able to make some real standout\nsandwiches, thanks to all your lessons![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_04
entries.text: Splendid. I’m happy to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_05
entries.text: Y’know, that stuff you taught in class was really\ntrue.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_06
entries.text: Hm? What are you referring to?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_07
entries.text: Like, how making food is better when you do it\nwith someone, and all that.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_065_08
entries.text: Digging in with my best buds makes food taste\nso much better than eating alone![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_01
entries.text: Hola, Primera! You sure shook up your\nparty, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_02
entries.text: Well, of course. I am La Primera, after all.\c\nHow could I set an example for other Trainers if I\ndon’t keep pushing myself to become stronger?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_03
entries.text: That checks out! I better keep up the pace, too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_04
entries.text: Well, I don’t plan on slowing down until I hand\nover the role of Top Champion to you...or indeed\r\nto Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_05
entries.text: Nooo! C’mon, Primera, don’t talk about that![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_06
entries.text: I’d rather you just stayed Primera forever![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_066_07
entries.text: Hah... If that’s the case, it seems I won’t be able\nto retire for a good while yet.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_01
entries.text: Why hello there, Penny. I didn’t realize you were\nhere.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_02
entries.text: Ch-Chairwoman Geeta?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_03
entries.text: Are you here to study and analyze this academy’s\nBP system?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_04
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Uh, no... [VAR 0x0100(0000)] invited me,
so
I
just
dropped
by
to
hang out...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_05
entries.text: Oh, is that so? My, my...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_08
entries.text: I am very glad to hear that. It seems you are\nindeed treasuring your friends, as you should.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_09
entries.text: Ohmygosh, my heart literally stopped! I thought\nI was in trouble for sure![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_067_10
entries.text: Please—you gotta stop with the ominous pauses!\nMy poor heart can’t take it![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_01
entries.text: I’m pleased to meet you properly.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_02
entries.text: Drayton—progeny of a long line of Dragon-type\nusers, if I’m not mistaken.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_03
entries.text: Hang on. Pretty sure I never mentioned that\nto you.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_04
entries.text: Ah, I beg your pardon.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_05
entries.text: But I am curious... What do you see yourself\ndoing in the future, Drayton?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_06
entries.text: I doubt I’m the guy you want to ask about future\nstuff.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_07
entries.text: All I really care about is enjoying the here\nand now.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_08
entries.text: So if you’re scouting out new League members,\nyou may wanna bark up another tree.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_09
entries.text: You see through my intentions, apparently.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_068_10
entries.text: I suppose your free-spirited nature is part of\nwhat makes you so strong.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_01
entries.text: Aaarveeen! Did I hear right that a certain floppy-\nhaired pal of mine started taking on Gyms?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_02
entries.text: Gah! You’re the last person I wanted to find\nout about that![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_03
entries.text: But...well, yeah! Figured I’d start small and try\none now and then, in between school and all.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_04
entries.text: Niiice! That’s a perfect first step on your path to\nbecoming Champion Arven![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_05
entries.text: No way! There’s no way I’m taking it that far![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_06
entries.text: It’s just, like...I dunno. I want to be able to stand\nbeside my best bud and feel like I belong there.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_07
entries.text: Oh, whoa! OK, I get it, I get it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_08
entries.text: So what I’m hearing is we should battle for the\nright to be [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s rival![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_069_09
entries.text: See?! This is why I didn’t want you to find out!\nI knew you’d be like this, you battle maniac![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_01
entries.text: So, Penny, which do you like better—our academy\nback home or Blueberry Academy?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_02
entries.text: Hmm. Well, they both get minus points since\nschools aren’t my happy place...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_03
entries.text: But if I had to pick, all the battle-obsessed\nstudents here make it feel way too intense,\r\nso our academy back home gets my vote![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_04
entries.text: Aw, what’s wrong with a little battle obsession?\nIt’s fun![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_05
entries.text: So you prefer Blueberry Academy, then?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_06
entries.text: Whoof. That’s a tough call...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_07
entries.text: But I think I gotta give it to our academy back\nhome, too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_08
entries.text: Ooh. How come?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_09
entries.text: Well, we’ve got our battle studies course, and\nour teachers are super nice![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_10
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And I’d never have met you and
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
if
we
hadn’t
enrolled
there, too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_070_11
entries.text: Huh... Yeah. Can’t argue with that.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_01
entries.text: Oh, Nemona! It’s been far too long! I don’t think\nwe’ve met since that party, have we?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_02
entries.text: Whoooa! Lacey, right?! Good to see you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_03
entries.text: I can’t believe you remembered my name from\njust that one time we met! That’s awesome![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_04
entries.text: Oh, no, it’s no more impressive than you\nremembering my name in return! And besides,\r\nhow could I forget you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_05
entries.text: You created such a stir, challenging my daddy to\na battle right there in your fancy party dress![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_06
entries.text: Yeah, I’m really sorry about that. Once I heard he\nwas a Gym Leader, I just couldn’t help myself...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_07
entries.text: But Daddy was so pleased with you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_08
entries.text: Do you know what he said? “Nothin’ wrong with\na young missy who knows what she wants!” Hehe![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_071_09
entries.text: Haha! Aww, I’m glad! Clay’s very kind![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_01
entries.text: Hey, Nemona, how’d you get so strong?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_02
entries.text: Awww! You called me strong! Thanks, Carmine![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_03
entries.text: Wha—? No, I wasn’t complimenting you. I was\nasking you a question! What’s your secret?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_04
entries.text: My secret? Hmm... My secret...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_05
entries.text: I guess working really hard and training my\nPokémon really hard![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_06
entries.text: Oh come on, I already do all that![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_07
entries.text: Sheesh, all I wanted was to get real strong real\nfast and surprise [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c\nGuess it’s not that easy.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_08
entries.text: Oooh, I dig the idea, though! Why don’t you and\nI do some training together![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_09
entries.text: Sure, but you’re way too strong, so...y’know...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_10
entries.text: Say no more—I know exactly what you want!\nMax power mode! The gloves are comin’ off![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_072_11
entries.text: That’s not what I was asking at all![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_01
entries.text: Man, Kieran, I can’t believe how fast you blasted\nyour way through the BB League and became\r\nChampion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_03
entries.text: But it turns out I’m just no good...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_04
entries.text: Whaaat?! What makes you say that?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_05
entries.text: I only thought about winning back then.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_06
entries.text: I trained and trained so much every day... I barely\nslept, and I hardly even ate.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_07
entries.text: I did all that and finally made it to Champion,\nbut in the end, I just got crushed anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_08
entries.text: I dunno about that, but I do know that it’s\nawesome how dedicated you can be![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_09
entries.text: It must mean you really love Pokémon, Kieran![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_10
entries.text: Huh... I guess I do like them. And that’s why\nI worked so hard...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_11
entries.text: I feel a bit better about it now. Thanks, Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_073_12
entries.text: Aw, don’t worry about it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_01
entries.text: You’re eating your vegetables, right?! Don’t\nmake me tell you again![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_02
entries.text: Ehh. It’s not like I’ll die if I don’t eat them, so\nwhat’s the point?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_03
entries.text: Seriously? Penny, you do know that you NEED to\neat veggies, right? Like—seriously?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_04
entries.text: ...You’re being weirdly insistent about this.\nWhat’s the worst that could happen?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_05
entries.text: Your body could get all...mushy and stuff! Till you\nmight seriously die! I’ve read about it in books![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_06
entries.text: Wait, what? Seriously?! I’m gonna need to see\nyour source here, Arven![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_07
entries.text: My...sauce? So if I put some sauce on your\nveggies, you’ll eat them?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_074_08
entries.text:
No, that’s not... Ugh, never mind. Just tell me
if that mushy-body thing is actually real!\c
Here, I’ll even eat a carrot or something right
now—just hurry up and tell me the truth!!![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_01
entries.text: So, seriously, why do you always carry that frying\npan around?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_02
entries.text: What kinda question is that? It’s so I can always\ncook if I want to, duh![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_03
entries.text: I even hug it as I go to sleep every night![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_04
entries.text: It’s not like you can cook while you’re sleeping,\nbut...sure?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_05
entries.text: Hey, you’re carrying around a big ol’ rucksack\ntoo! It’s full of camping gear, yeah?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_06
entries.text: Oh! You noticed? Looks like you’re quite the\nbright little spark yourself![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_07
entries.text: With this handy bag of mine, I can do more than\njust whip up a meal anytime I want—I’m ready to\r\ncamp out under the stars anywhere I like![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_075_08
entries.text: Under the stars?! Like, you just sleep outdoors?\nWow, no way! That’s so cool![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_01
entries.text: So, anything to spill about any, you know...special\nfeelings? Between you and anybody else in your\r\nlittle Paldea crew, I mean.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_02
entries.text: Special feelings...? Oh! Yeah, you know what—\nthere was something![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_03
entries.text: For real? There was?! W-well, can you tell me\nabout it?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_04
entries.text: So, we were all jumping on Koraidon’s back to\ndive down into the Great Crater, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_05
entries.text: So, we were all jumping on Miraidon’s back to\ndive down into the Great Crater, you know?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_06
entries.text: Uh-huh? Go on![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_07
entries.text: Man, taking a leap into the open air above Area\nZero like that—talk about a special feeling![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_076_09
entries.text: Oh, sheesh, what an anticlimax! You innocent\nlittle thing...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_01
entries.text: Your partner Mabosstiff is really special\nto you, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_02
entries.text: That’s right! He and I’ve been best buds since\nI was a little kid and he was just a little Maschiff![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_03
entries.text: Hey, that’s just like me and my Hydrapple! It’s\nbeen with me since it was a li’l Applin.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_04
entries.text: So is Hydrapple your best bud?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_05
entries.text: Hmmm, well... My Poliwrath and Politoed are\npretty special to me, too... Oh, and I really like\r\nmy Yanmega.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_06
entries.text: Aw man, and Furret’s also a precious pal of mine.\nI guess I just can’t pick a favorite...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_07
entries.text: Hey, that’s fine! There’s nothing wrong with\nthinking every one of your Pokémon is the best![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: pair_talk_077_08
entries.text: Hehehe... I guess that’s an option too, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_01
entries.text: You sent out a Sylveon earlier, didn’t you? It’s\njust too cute, isn’t it?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_02
entries.text: GAH! Wuh? Wh-who are you?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_03
entries.text: Oh! I’m sorry, but I couldn’t resist! My name is\nLacey, and I can’t help myself around cute things![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_04
entries.text: Sorry. You just kinda...surprised me there...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_05
entries.text: Um! But you said my Sylveon was cute, right?\nTh-thanks...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_06
entries.text: Oh, of course! Cute things are a treasure meant\nto be shared with all![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_07
entries.text: I, uh...don’t really get what you mean by that,\nbut...my other Veevees are pretty cute, too.\r\nWanna see?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_078_08
entries.text: Oh my gosh, do I ever![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_01
entries.text: Hey, Penny, you’re pretty good with machines\nand stuff, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_02
entries.text: Better than most... What’s up?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_03
entries.text: I wanna get a new profile pic. Do you think you\ncan take a shot of me real quick?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_04
entries.text: Well, THAT’S a whole different skill than being\ngood with machines!\c\nWhy d’you want me to do it, anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_05
entries.text: I mean, if I’m gonna update the pic, I might as\nwell get an amazing one from someone who\r\nknows what they’re doing, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_06
entries.text: Huh... But you know you’ll get pretty much the\nsame result no matter who takes the pic, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_07
entries.text: I mean, at least on the outside, you’re really\npretty, so—[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_08
entries.text: Huh? Wait, what did you just say? That last bit\nin particular.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_09
entries.text: I said you’re really pretty, so it doesn’t matter\nwho takes the ph—[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_10
entries.text: Oooh, music to my ears! One more time! Repeat\nit for me, come on![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_079_11
entries.text: Uggghhh! Why are you like this?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_01
entries.text: So, errr... Nice weather...don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_02
entries.text: I-is it? I’ve been inside all day, so I dunno...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_03
entries.text: A-ah, yeah, that’s true! My bad![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_04
entries.text: Looks like we’re not ready for casual one-on-one\nchats just yet, huh...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_05
entries.text: Hehe... Yeah, guess not.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_06
entries.text: B-but it’s not like I don’t want to hang out with\nyou! I really want us to get along![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_07
entries.text: Me too! We’re friends now, after all![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_080_08
entries.text: Y-yeah! We sure are![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_01
entries.text: Hey, Amarys! Can I have some of those\nsupplements that let Pokémon fly?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_02
entries.text: ...Why do you want them?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_03
entries.text: ’Cause I wanna fly?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_04
entries.text: ...And why do you want to fly?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_05
entries.text: ’Cause flying sounds like fun?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_06
entries.text: ...I don’t follow you. Permission to use flying\nsupplements denied.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_07
entries.text: Aw, c’mon! You’re such a wet blanket! I wanna go\nflying on Magmortar![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_081_08
entries.text: ...That’s absurd.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_01
entries.text: You seem to be fired up again today, Crispin.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_02
entries.text: Well, yeah! I had a big, hearty meal and\neverything![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_03
entries.text: Hee hee! Growing boys do eat quite a lot, don’t\nthey?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_04
entries.text: You bet! We’re always hungry, all the time![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_05
entries.text: What, even right after you eat? That makes no\nsense, silly![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_06
entries.text: Oh, but what was it you wanted to talk to me\nabout?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_07
entries.text: Oh, uh, right! Right, yeah, well... I wanted to tell\nyou, uh... See...maybe you and I could, y’know...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_08
entries.text: Uhhh, never mind! Not today! I’ll tell you another\ntime! Heh heh... Heh...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_082_09
entries.text: Ah, this again? Honestly...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_01
entries.text: Hey, Drayton! You were up to somethin’ behind\nthe scenes, weren’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_02
entries.text: Whoa-ho. That came out of nowhere. What do\nyou think I was doing?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_03
entries.text: Like...I dunno, it’s hard for me to explain, but...\nyou roped in [VAR 0x0100(0000)], and, uh...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_04
entries.text: Oooh, you’re on the right track! Keep it up![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_05
entries.text: You wanted to, like, get the League Club back to\nthe way it was...? And...something about Kieran?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_06
entries.text: Whoa, that’s...actually pretty solid! One last\nleap, Crispin. You can do it![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_07
entries.text: Gaaahhh, I give up! I’m not good at usin’ my\nhead like this![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_08
entries.text: Aww, so close.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_09
entries.text: My point is! You need to stop playin’ the villain,\nDrayton! Otherwise people are actually gonna\r\nstart thinkin’ you ARE a bad guy![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_10
entries.text: Next time, if you wanna cook up a scheme, at\nleast talk to me about it![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_083_11
entries.text: Heh heh heh. Fair point, buddy.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_02
entries.text: Hey, Crispin... You’re in the same class as Kiki,\nright?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_03
entries.text: Yep! Same class![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_04
entries.text: How’s...how’s Kiki doing since he...y’know, since\nhe came back?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_05
entries.text: We study, we talk, we have battles... It’s pretty\nnormal, I guess?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_06
entries.text: Oh, yeah? And nobody’s picking on him or\nanything, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_07
entries.text: Well, I mean...some kids are scared of him ’cause\nof how he was...[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_08
entries.text: But he’s much more approachable now, so I think\nit’s all good! I like Kieran how he is![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_09
entries.text: Y’know... You’re a nice guy, Crispin. Even if you\nare kind of dense sometimes.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_084_10
entries.text: Did you really need to throw in that diss?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_01
entries.text: Hey, did you see that new episode yesterday?\nIt was awesome![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_02
entries.text: S-sorry... I haven’t seen it yet.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_03
entries.text: Why’d you apologize?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_04
entries.text: Ah—well, I, uh... Wait, why DID I apologize...?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_05
entries.text: I guess ’cause you went out of your way to talk to\nme, and I couldn’t keep the conversation going?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_06
entries.text: Oh c’mon, I don’t mind that kinda thing![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_07
entries.text: Yeah... Yeah, I guess you don’t.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_085_08
entries.text: Hey, how ’bout we watch next week’s episode\nin your room, then?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_01
entries.text: How do you define “cuteness”?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_02
entries.text: Gracious, that’s a difficult question to answer...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_03
entries.text: I assumed you would have a clear grasp of the\nconcept since you use the term so frequently...[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_04
entries.text:
Oh, that...simply wells up within me, from the
bottom of my heart! I can’t hold it in!\c
But I can’t say it’s something I’ve thought hard
about. It’s more like a natural response...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_05
entries.text: Then let us attempt to define cuteness here and\nnow. How about...pink? Is that cute?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_06
entries.text: Yes! Pink is definitely cute![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_07
entries.text: And smallness? Is that cute?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_08
entries.text: That’s right! Small things are quite often cute![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_09
entries.text: But big things can be cute, too. I don’t think you\ncan simply define cuteness as “being small.”[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_086_10
entries.text: Cuteness is...complex, I see.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_01
entries.text: You submitted your report seven minutes and\n20 seconds late, I see...[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_02
entries.text: Hey, that means I submitted it, right? Do we\ngotta sweat the small stuff?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_03
entries.text: I...I cannot believe that you find such conduct\nacceptable.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_04
entries.text: I dunno. The teacher seemed pretty thrilled with\nmy work.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_05
entries.text: That is...doubtful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_06
entries.text: Why is it that you never stick to schedules,\nDrayton?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_07
entries.text: Why don’t I stick to schedules?! Aw, c’mon, you\nknow why...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_08
entries.text: ’Cause I’m too busy stickin’ it to the man![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_087_10
entries.text: Heh. And the crowd goes wild![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_01
entries.text: Here you go! Some Syrupy Apples, straight from\nKitakami![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_02
entries.text: Thank you, Carmine. I truly appreciate it.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_03
entries.text: You always ask for apples whenever I go home...\nSure you aren’t tired of them?\c\nWe have mochi too, you know...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_04
entries.text: I have no need for mochi. Kitakami’s apples are\nfar superior.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_05
entries.text: Well, I guess they are a lot sweeter than the\napples you can get elsewhere, yeah...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_06
entries.text: The high sugar content gives them a superb\nflavor, and they stay fresh for a long time.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_07
entries.text: I also...like to use them for still life compositions.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_08
entries.text: Oh, that’s right! Of course you’d use them for\nyour paintings![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_09
entries.text: I would very much enjoy painting a tree laden\nwith apples someday.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_10
entries.text: You should come to Kitakami sometime! I’ll show\nyou around myself![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_088_11
entries.text: That would be lovely.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_01
entries.text: I’m gonna really try my best this time, Amarys.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_02
entries.text: I am...very glad to hear it.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_03
entries.text: It is good to see you back at the academy.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_04
entries.text: I know you and my sis were all worried about\nme... I’m really sorry about that.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_05
entries.text: Your apology is unnecessary.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_06
entries.text: Just keep putting one foot in front of the other.\nThat is all you need to do.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_07
entries.text: Yeah, you’re right! Thanks, Amarys![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_08
entries.text: “One foot in front of the other”... Yeah!\nWhen you put it like that, it’s so true![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_089_09
entries.text: ...I wish you all the best, Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_01
entries.text: That’s it! Today you are definitely doing your\nduty as an Elite Four member—and no slacking![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_02
entries.text: Hey, we both know I’ll just mess things up, and\nyou guys’ll have to do more work in the end.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_03
entries.text: Th-that is...entirely likely but beside the point![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_04
entries.text: First things first—your attitude! You have to truly\nwant to do the work in order to do it well![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_05
entries.text: Chop-chop! On your feet! Then, take these\ndocuments here—[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_06
entries.text: Awww, c’monnn. I’m so sluggish...so tired...\nso sleepy...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_07
entries.text: No! That is just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_08
entries.text: It feels pretty right to me![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_090_09
entries.text: Ooooh, you! YOU![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_01
entries.text: Hey, so...some boy asked you to step out with\nhim earlier, huh? What was that about?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_02
entries.text: Oh... You saw that?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_03
entries.text: Yep! With my own two eyes![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_04
entries.text: Well, he said he wanted to talk about something,\nso he took me over to this empty classroom...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_05
entries.text: He wanted to talk? Like, TALK talk? You’ve\ngotta give me the details![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_06
entries.text: Oh! No, there’s nothing to tell...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_07
entries.text: The moment I told him who my daddy was,\nhe was off in a flash![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_091_08
entries.text: Wow... You’re way more ruthless than you look.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_01
entries.text: How are things going for you, Kieran? No trouble\nkeeping up with your classes or anything?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_02
entries.text: Eep... Well, actually...I’m pretty out of the loop...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_03
entries.text: I didn’t study at all during my break...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_04
entries.text: That’s only natural! I don’t think anyone could\nexpect otherwise.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_05
entries.text: I tried asking Crispin, but he wasn’t any help...\nSeems like he hasn’t been keeping up either.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_06
entries.text: Oh. That’s also...quite natural. I wouldn’t expect\notherwise.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_07
entries.text: Well, I can teach you! And I can lend you my old\nnotes from last year![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_08
entries.text: Wha—you sure? But I was such a jerk to you...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_09
entries.text: Bzzt! Nope! Wrong! What’s past is past, and I’m\nnot one for holding grudges. That’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_10
entries.text: We’re clubmates, aren’t we? We should be able\nto depend on one another for anything![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: pair_talk_092_11
entries.text: Y-yeah, you’re right! Thanks, Lacey![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_01
entries.text: C’mon, Carmine. Just lemme copy your\nhomework. C’mooon.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_02
entries.text: That’s really not how you should go about asking\npeople for favors, y’know...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_03
entries.text: Anyway, the answer is NO! Every time I lend you\nmy notes, they come back all crumpled up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_04
entries.text: Pleeease! I’ll iron ’em before I give ’em back![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_05
entries.text: How about just not crumpling them up to begin\nwith...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_06
entries.text: Maaan, Lacey and Amarys wouldn’t let me copy\ntheirs either.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_07
entries.text: Pleeease! I’m begging! Can’t you see me\nbowing my head in humility?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_093_08
entries.text: The only thing I see is a bozo kicking back and\nrelaxing![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_01
entries.text: Yo, ex-Champ.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_02
entries.text: H-hey, Drayton... I just wanted to say, um...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_03
entries.text: What’s wrong, ex-Champ?! Something happen?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_04
entries.text: I wish you’d stop calling me that...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_05
entries.text: By the way, I meant to ask...what does an\nex-Champion eat for dinner these days?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_06
entries.text: I told you to stop calling me that! Get it through\nyour thick skull already![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_07
entries.text: Heh heh. I’m just indulgin’ in some well-earned\npayback here. Don’t mind me![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: pair_talk_094_08
entries.text: Aw man... Whatever, Drayton...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_01
entries.text: So, how long are you going to keep your hair like\nthat, Kiki?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_02
entries.text: Huh, why? Does it look weird?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_03
entries.text: *sigh*... I’ve been meaning to say this all along...\c\nYou really should stop trying to be all edgy. It’s\nnot a good look for you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_04
entries.text: Wh-what?! I’m not trying to be edgy![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_05
entries.text: I just put my hair up so I can let loose during\nbattles! Aw man...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_06
entries.text: What, so you can’t “let loose” unless you tie your\nhair up? Aww, that’s too cute![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_07
entries.text: Shut up, Sis! You’re such a dummy![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: pair_talk_095_08
entries.text: Hey, what’d you just call me?! You’d better watch\nyour mouth if you know what’s good for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_01
entries.text: You seem to be smiling a lot more often these\ndays, Rika.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_02
entries.text: Huh?! What’s this all of a sudden?! Kind of a\ncreepy thing to mention outta the blue...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_03
entries.text: I do beg your pardon.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_04
entries.text: I simply assumed you were in a good mood,\nseeing as you now get to meet your favorite\r\nTrainer more regularly.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_05
entries.text: Whaaat? I don’t know what you’re goin’ on\nabout. Ol’ Rika doesn’t have favorites![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_06
entries.text: Heh... Of course. I’m sure you don’t.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_07
entries.text: Hey, look who’s talking! You seem to have a real\nhigh opinion of h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer too, boss![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_08
entries.text: Oh my. It seems I’ve been found out.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_09
entries.text: Sheesh... Just don’t steal h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer away from Nemona.\nShe’ll throw a fit![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: pair_talk_096_10
entries.text: Hmm... I’d prefer to avoid that. I’ll keep your\nadvice in mind.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_01
entries.text: Geeta! Geeta![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_02
entries.text: Why hello, Poppy. What can I do for you?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_03
entries.text: I’m making a drawing of you, Geeta![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_04
entries.text: A drawing of...me?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_05
entries.text: That’s right![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_06
entries.text: Once I’m done coloring it, I’ll give it to you![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_08
entries.text: Do you know the size of the paper you’re using?\nI must order a frame for it immediately.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: pair_talk_097_09
entries.text: Oh, um, um, I’m not sure...[VAR 0x0114(0014)]
